stories.title: Texas executes man with drug from botched Tennessee case
new_facts: Texas executed Jamaal Howard after Supreme Court rejected appeal citing pentobarbital risks from Pike's botched execution
Specifies Howard's execution came one week after Pike's failed execution
Pike's attorneys report she has pneumonia and cannot move her arms after the botched execution
Attorneys accuse Tennessee officials of delaying access to Pike over two hours after she regained consciousness
Lawyers say Pike was nearly taken off life support before she unexpectedly woke
stories.line: Texas executed a man using the same drug involved in a failed execution in Tennessee a week prior, despite legal challenges citing that botch.

stories.title: Musk blames Indian telecom oligarchs for Starlink delay
new_facts: SpaceX signed MOUs with Jio and Airtel in 2025; Musk accuses 'certain oligarchs' of blocking Starlink launch
Trump will award Musk and other tech executives the National Medal of Science on Thursday
stories.line: Musk claims Indian telecom oligarchs are blocking Starlink's market entry to protect their dominance; SpaceX has signed agreements with two carriers.

stories.title: German government search engine drops Mistral for open-source AI models
new_facts: Ecosia dropped Mistral for open-source models, including Chinese ones, over quality complaints.
stories.line: German government search engine Ecosia switches from Mistral AI to open-source models, including Chinese alternatives, over performance concerns.

stories.title: Valkyries hit $100m revenue milestone as Dream advances to WNBA Finals
new_facts: Valkyries become first WNBA team to surpass $100m annual revenue; valued at $1bn.
Dream take 2-0 semifinal lead over Liberty; Reese scored 6 OT points, Hillmon's go-ahead layup won it.
Final score 101-98; Reese scored 23 points total; Hillmon's layup came with 20.8 seconds left; Ionescu missed free throws.
stories.line: Golden State Valkyries reached $100m annual revenue in their second season; Atlanta Dream advanced to WNBA Finals.

stories.title: EU trade envoy arrives in Beijing for tense car-tariff talks
new_facts: EU's top trade envoy in Beijing; Brussels blames China's car exports for tens of thousands of lost manufacturing jobs
Talks center on €1bn daily EU-China trade deficit and rare earth export restrictions
stories.line: EU and China begin trade negotiations in Beijing as tensions escalate over tariffs and automotive sales.

stories.title: Tax filing deadline tomorrow; extension option available
new_facts: Tax filing deadline is tomorrow; explains how to file for a filing extension.
stories.line: Tax filing deadline is tomorrow; taxpayers can request a six-month extension if they need more time.

stories.title: Hurricane Isaias strengthens, targets northern Gulf Coast this weekend
new_facts: Isaias becomes first hurricane of 2026 Atlantic season, threatening Mississippi to Florida Panhandle
NHC says Isaias strengthened to Category 1 hurricane, warns of coastal flooding, damaging winds, heavy rain
Tropical Storm Isaias forms in Gulf, forecast to become hurricane by Thursday, approach northern Gulf Coast Friday
States of emergency declared in Alabama and Florida as storm nears Gulf Coast
stories.line: Hurricane Isaias is strengthening in the Gulf and expected to reach the northern coast this weekend.

stories.title: Bronze RFK bust stolen from outside stadium during demolition project
new_facts: Bronze RFK bust stolen from outside demolished RFK Stadium, undetected for ~two weeks per police report.
stories.line: A bronze bust of Robert F. Kennedy, displayed outside RFK Stadium since 1969, was stolen during a stadium demolition project.

stories.title: Dominion presses defamation cases against Giuliani, Powell
new_facts: Dominion has pending defamation lawsuits against election deniers including Giuliani and Powell
stories.line: Dominion Voting Systems continues pursuing defamation lawsuits against prominent Trump allies for false claims about the 2020 election.
